name: Steirer Stub'n
kurzbeschreibung: **Tyrolean Tavern in Krün** – A cozy retreat in the heart of the **Zillertal Alps**, where hearty **Tiroler** hospitality meets rustic charm. Savor traditional dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Schlutzkrapfen**, and **Kaspressknödel**, paired with crisp **Tiroler Bier** or smooth **Apfelstrudel** for dessert. Warm up by the crackling fireplace or step outside to breathtaking mountain views. Whether you're craving a hearty meal or just a moment of relaxation, this **Stub’n** is your perfect alpine escape. **Willkommen in Krün!**
